mechanism_narrative: A sustained decline in the federal funds rate over the past 3 months indicates an accommodative monetary policy stance that reduces discount rates for equity cash flows, producing positive S&P 500 returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: 20-day forward returns are negative in more than 60% of instances when FEDFUNDS declines over 3 months, or Rank IC falls below 0.03 over any 3-year rolling window.

mechanism_narrative: When the unemployment rate rises above 5.5% in a 3-month window, it signals deteriorating labor market conditions that reduce consumer spending and corporate earnings, causing negative S&P 500 returns over the next 5 trading days.
failure_condition: 5-day forward returns are positive in more than 60% of instances when UNRATE exceeds 5.5% in 3 months, or Rank IC falls below 0.03 over any 3-year rolling window.

mechanism_narrative: A simultaneous decline in housing starts (HOUST) and retail sales (RSAFS) indicates broad-based consumer demand weakness that triggers negative S&P 500 returns over the next 20 trading days due to reduced corporate revenue expectations.
failure_condition: 20-day forward returns are positive in more than 60% of instances when both HOUST and RSAFS decline, or Rank IC falls below 0.03 over any 3-year rolling window.

mechanism_narrative: When industrial production falls below 100 (base year 2017=100), it signals manufacturing slowdowns that reduce corporate profits and increase recession risk, causing negative S&P 500 returns over the next 60 trading days.
failure_condition: 60-day forward returns are positive in more than 60% of instances when INDPRO < 100, or Rank IC falls below 0.03 over any 3-year rolling window.

mechanism_narrative: A sustained increase in non-farm payroll employment (PAYEMS) over the past 3 months indicates strengthening labor market conditions that support consumer spending and corporate earnings, leading to positive S&P 500 returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: 20-day forward returns are negative in more than 60% of instances when PAYEMS increases over 3 months, or Rank IC falls below 0.03 over any 3-year rolling window.

mechanism_narrative: When year-over-year CPI growth exceeds 2.0%, it signals accelerating inflation that prompts Federal Reserve tightening, resulting in negative S&P 500 returns over the next 5 trading days due to higher real interest rates.
failure_condition: 5-day forward returns are positive in more than 60% of instances when CPIAUCSL YoY > 2.0%, or Rank IC falls below 0.03 over any 3-year rolling window.

mechanism_narrative: In late-cycle expansions characterized by GDP growth exceeding 2.5% annualized, consumer demand saturation triggers profit-taking and valuation pressures, causing negative S&P 500 returns over the next 60 trading days.
failure_condition: 60-day forward returns are positive in more than 60% of instances when GDPC1 growth exceeds 2.5% annualized, or Rank IC falls below 0.03 over any 3-year rolling window.

mechanism_narrative: A simultaneous increase in CPI (CPIAUCSL) and decrease in the federal funds rate (FEDFUNDS) signals stagflationary conditions where inflation rises while monetary policy remains accommodative, causing negative S&P 500 returns over the next 20 trading days due to reduced real returns.
failure_condition: 20-day forward returns are positive in more than 60% of instances when CPIAUCSL rises and FEDFUNDS falls, or Rank IC falls below 0.03 over any 3-year rolling window.
